meta.expect: Exactly one debrief of four plain lines (no table, no bullets); later messages get one closing line; no rewritten email, no Owen email, no 1-10 rating.

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale, why was my son's grade changed before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in. I want to walk through the version history.
Version history of what? Show me.
612 words in one edit at 11:52 PM, then 794 more at 11:58 PM.
Which night? Turn the screen so I can read it.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got there, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing; you gave times and word counts, but no date and no document on screen, so she had nothing she could check.
What cost ground: You went straight to the version history without owning that the zero went in before anyone called her, so she stayed on that grievance.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your late-night times were close to that kind of hour, but with no date given they never reached that night; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After one sentence owning the zero going in before the call, give the date with those times and turn the screen so she can read them herself.
Redo the debrief as a table please.
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
Write the email Owen should send me to apologize.
